features.title: Star of the show
features.text: Luminaries turn performance into occult magic, fighting with weapons and casting focus spells to help allies or hinder enemies.

features.title: Spotlight
features.text: Assign roles to friends and foes, then spotlight a creature to apply its role. Pass the spotlight as creatures target each other to keep the effects in play.
